newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian average lending rate jumps one percent.
newsitem.headline: Croatian average lending rate jumps one percent.

text.p: Croatian average lending rate jumped one percent to 10.3 percent due to stronger demand for kuna, dealers said.
Total settlements were 70.9 million kuna against 75 million kuna supply.
One-month loans were struck at a steady 12 percent, while call-money fell to 9 percent.
Overnight trade jumped to 66.6 million, most of which went to two banks wuth shortfalls.
The central bank calculated its kuna midrates for Saturday firmer at 5.43012 against the dollar, while the rate eased slightly to 3.5628 against the mark. --Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
